ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white (>80% of surface) with sharp contrast against low-intensity black perimeter borders and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity central core; low-intensity dark banding along the trailing edge (approx. 20-50 pixels wide); high-density dark pixel clusters localized at the peduncle-notch interface and terminal lobe tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 52 degrees; bounding-box depth is roughly 18% of the visible vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude micro-serrations along the median-to-distal boundaries; macro-level irregular fracturing and 'chips' localized on both the far left and far right terminal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating at the notch, transitioning to a broad convex sweep through the mid-lobe, and ending in an irregular, jagged distal trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of 6-8 circular dark-rimmed pixels (rosettes) on the left distal tip; isolated circular marks scattered along the right trailing edge boundary.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, near-vertical low-intensity linear tracks visible on the right lobe, likely indicative of superficial rake marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue erosion and jagged fracturing on the rightmost fluke tip; dense dark pigmentation column extending from the peduncle into the primary notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Isolated dark focal point (spot) in the upper mid-section of the right lobe; unique 'C-shaped' dark mark on the extreme left tip.
